description: This source file defines a class MockDoorLock that simulates a door lock device for testing purposes. It extends a base device class and implements capabilities like BatteryPowered and Tamperable, with methods to lock, unlock, toggle lock state, and manage battery and tamper status.

classes.name: MockDoorLock
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Zigbee-enabled door lock device with capabilities for battery status and tamper detection.

methods.name: MockDoorLock
methods.description: Constructs a new MockDoorLock with specified name and optional EUI64 identifier, initializing its clusters.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Returns whether the door lock is currently locked.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Sets the door lock state to locked.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Sets the door lock state to unlocked.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the current lock state.

methods.name: isLowBattery
methods.description: Checks if the battery level is low.

methods.name: setLowBattery
methods.description: Sets the low battery status.

methods.name: setBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Updates the battery voltage value.

methods.name: getBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Retrieves the current battery voltage.

methods.name: isTampered
methods.description: Returns whether the device has been tampered with.

methods.name: setTampered
methods.description: Sets the tampered status.

methods.name: isInvalidCodeEntryLimit
methods.description: Checks if the invalid code entry limit is reached.

methods.name: setInvalidCodeEntryLimit
methods.description: Sets the invalid code entry limit status.

methods.name: setLockBoltJammed
methods.description: Indicates if the lock bolt is jammed.

methods.name: isLockBoltJammed
methods.description: Checks if the lock bolt is jammed.

methods.name: addPin
methods.description: Adds a PIN code with associated userId, status, and type.

methods.name: getPinCount
methods.description: Returns the number of PIN codes stored.

methods.name: getMaxPinCodeLength
methods.description: Returns maximum PIN code length supported.

methods.name: getMinPinCodeLength
methods.description: Returns minimum PIN code length supported.

methods.name: getMaxPinCodesSupported
methods.description: Returns maximum number of PIN codes supported.

methods.name: getAutoRelockSeconds
methods.description: Gets the auto-relock timeout in seconds.

methods.name: setAutoRelockSeconds
methods.description: Sets the auto-relock timeout in seconds.

methods.name: getPins
methods.description: Returns a collection of PIN entries.
